correctness.rationale: For any subset of an ordinal Alexandrov initial-segment space, the omega-derivative is exactly the tail beginning at the supremum of its first omega elements (or empty for finite sets). Deriving a tail adds omega to the left endpoint; at limits, intersection takes the supremum. The transfinite induction proves all ordinal-valued formulas, point deletion and minimal realizing order types, including empty/limit boundaries. Independent finite analogue checks in checker.py passed 147,450 comparisons plus 1,100 rank cases; they are not treated as proof of infinite cases.
